categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of magnesium alloy and aluminum alloy precision die-casting products and related die-casting molds. The main products include automotive display system components, new energy vehicle powertrain components, automotive center console components, automotive seat components, automotive lighting components, and high-cleanliness autonomous driving module components for automotive applications, as well as electric bicycle functional and structural components and garden machinery spare parts for non-automotive applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes precision die-casting technology as its core manufacturing method, employing high-pressure die-casting and semi-solid injection molding techniques. Core technologies include crack-prevention forming technology, localized pressure forming technology, ejection deformation prevention control technology, magnesium alloy electrostatic spraying technology, magnesium alloy melt protection technology, magnesium ash de-burning technology, magnesium dust collection and purification control technology, large flat surface and thin-wall deformation-prone casting processing technology, and complex tool design and application technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major automotive manufacturers including BMW, Audi, Porsche, Cadillac, Volkswagen, General Motors, Peugeot, Ford, Nissan, Hongqi, Chery, Great Wall, Geely, BYD, Changan, Tesla, Xiaomi, NIO, Seeres, and XPeng. Products are applied in traditional vehicles, new energy vehicles, electric bicycles, and garden machinery tools. The company has established itself as a Tier 1 or Tier 2 supplier in automotive supply chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province. It has established subsidiaries in Singapore and Thailand to expand its global presence. The company conducts both domestic sales (70.20% of 2024 revenue) and international sales (29.80% of 2024 revenue), with operations extending to North America and Europe through overseas sales representatives.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, functioning as a precision component manufacturer and supplier. It produces die-casting components and molds that are supplied directly to automotive manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers, positioning itself as a critical link between raw material suppliers and end-vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing magnesium alloy precision die-casting technology and expanding applications in new energy vehicles, intelligent cockpit systems, and autonomous driving modules. Strategic priorities include developing large-scale integrated magnesium alloy components, advancing semi-solid casting technology, enhancing product cleanliness and precision, and expanding global production capacity through facilities in Fenghua and Thailand. The company emphasizes lightweight material innovation and design optimization.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of precision die-casting products and molds to automotive manufacturers and suppliers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a made-to-order basis with some advance inventory production, and employs various delivery modes including direct shipment, intermediate warehouse distribution, and consignment arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading specialist in magnesium alloy precision die-casting with first-mover advantages in this niche segment. It holds the status of a national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise, a key backbone enterprise in China's die-casting mold industry, and a high-quality development demonstration enterprise in Ningbo's casting industry. The company competes with other precision die-casting manufacturers but differentiates itself through early focus on magnesium alloy applications and comprehensive technical capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized precision manufacturing enterprise with 2024 revenue of approximately 408.6 million yuan, representing 16.01% growth from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 80.3 million yuan in 2024. Total assets reached 1.25 billion yuan at year-end 2024, with shareholders' equity of 1.11 billion yuan. The company demonstrates steady growth trajectory with improving operational cash flow (29.69% increase in 2024) and consistent profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through integrated one-stop service capabilities combining mold design, high-pressure and semi-solid die-casting, precision machining, and surface treatment. Key competitive advantages include early market entry in magnesium alloy applications, comprehensive technical expertise across the full production chain, rapid response capability to customer design modifications, advanced quality control systems with IATF 16949 certification, and established relationships with premium automotive brands. The company emphasizes lightweight material solutions, precision manufacturing, and innovation in new energy vehicle component applications.
